info.title: SocialKit API
info.description: Unified REST API for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn. Transcripts, stats, comments, summaries, downloads — plus bulk variants. All endpoints accept both GET (query params) and POST (JSON body). See https://docs.socialkit.dev for guides and pricing.

accessKey.name: x-access-key
accessKey.description: Project access key. Get one from https://dashboard.socialkit.dev. May also be passed as `?access_key=` query string.
